summary: enti istat --codice must resolve the ISTAT code from the CKAN Enti dataset (one row per entity), never from the AOO dataset.
reason: Entities with zero AOOs (e.g. professional orders such as oam_2) have no row in the AOO dataset, so the lookup reported them as nonexistent; the Enti dataset carries Codice_comune_ISTAT of every entity's seat.
